title: pilosella floribunda
intro: Pilosella floribunda, commonly known as Autumn Hawk's-beard, is a perennial plant in the dandelion family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions like arthritis and digestive issues. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress, with its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenoids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and potential applications.
